//: TEST FIXTURE — stands in for andy-containers/config/registration.json (a sibling repo absent in CI). Supplies the andy-containers-api confidential client used by TokenExchangeIntegrationTests so the RFC 8693 rejection paths run for real instead of fake-skipping on invalid_client. token_exchange is enabled and CustomWebApplicationFactory pairs it with a TokenExchange:Policies entry (actor=andy-containers-api, audience=urn:andy-models-api) so DbSeeder grants the matching rsr: resource permission. The secret env var is intentionally unset so the Development fallback yields 'andy-containers-api-secret-change-in-production'.

service.name: andy-containers
service.description: Test fixture manifest supplying andy-containers-api for hermetic token-exchange integration tests.
